implementation: All three JSON documents are parsed and schema-validated before publication.
Each staged file is written as a same-directory sibling with Flush(true) and read-back hash verification.
The original existence and bytes are snapshotted; every uncommitted target is rechecked before each replacement.
A failed publication rolls back already-published targets while preserving a third-version/manual edit.
Missing original outputs remain missing after rollback; successful output bytes match the prior correct replay.
